paper_title: Improved limits on the coupling of ultralight bosonic dark matter to photons from optical atomic clock comparisons
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (scalar photon coupling as in L = phi*(d_e/4mu0)*F_munu F^munu)
notes: Paper (Filzinger et al., PTB, arXiv:2301.03433) presents new measured 95% CL bounds on scalar UBDM-photon coupling d_e from Yb+ E3/E2 and Yb+ E3/Sr optical clock comparisons over m ~ 1e-24 to 2e-17 eV. No numerical table is provided; the exclusion curve (Fig. 4) was reconstructed from text values: flat amplitude bounds A ~ 2e-17 (E3/E2, k_alpha=6.95) and ~7e-18 (E3/Sr, k_alpha=6.01, dominant above 1e-20 eV), converted via |d_e| = 3 * omega * A / k_alpha * sqrt(c^2/(8 pi G rho_DM)) with rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (factor 3 for stochastic DM amplitude fluctuations, as applied in the paper). Below f ~ 1/T ~ 1.4e-8 Hz (m ~ 5.8e-23 eV) the amplitude bound degrades as 1/omega^2, giving d_e ~ 1/m scaling. Points are approximate (factor ~2 accuracy) reconstructions of the combined (best) limit.
